headline: Basing above $0.0879 low after 66% markdown

meta.market_state_note: Downtrend intact; the $0.088-0.097 base is a pause below heavy supply. Setup is valid but not actionable at spot — favour shorting a rally into $0.097-0.105 or a confirmed break of $0.0879, not chasing at $0.093.

factors.evidence: Multi-month markdown from ~$0.29 to $0.079 (-66% over the window). The recent local top $0.139 failed, then an 8-session impulse broke the $0.105-0.108 range floor and printed fresh lows at $0.088. Clean LH/LL.
Price $0.093 is below the 20 EMA (computed from daily closes).
Price below; 20 EMA ($0.107) is below 50 EMA ($0.110) — bearish stack.
Price is ~62% below AVWAP; never reclaimed.
Below the midline, in bearish territory; not yet at an oversold extreme (30).
The breakdown days carried the heaviest volume (115M, 138M); today's bounce is light (~18M).
Persistent 4H downtrend $0.139→$0.0879; last ~2.5 days chopping sideways $0.088-0.097 just above the low. No reclaim of any swing high; lower highs intact.
Price $0.0931 is hugging / just below the 4H 20 EMA.
RSI rising off the lows; a mild bullish divergence (price HL $0.090 vs $0.0879, RSI HL). Below 50 but stabilising.
Decline bars ran 29-34M; the base bars have collapsed to 3-10M — sell-side exhaustion into the low.

setup.thesis: Short the bearish trend continuation — preferably on a rally into the $0.097-0.105 supply, or on a confirmed 4H break/acceptance below $0.0879 — targeting the $0.0791 cycle low, then a measured extension toward $0.072-0.075.
setup.not: Not a Breakout/Reversal (no bullish structure); only superficially a Range (the range is a pause inside a trend).

evidence_matrix.reading: LH + LL; broke $0.105-0.108 range floor, fresh lows $0.088
Mild bullish divergence (price HL / RSI HL) at the lows
$0.0879 sweep held; $0.0791 cycle low = sell-side liquidity below

analyst_summary: ALGO is uniformly bearish — 7 bearish scorecard factors and zero bullish, with price below every EMA and ~62% under AVWAP after a 66% markdown.

The $0.088-0.097 chop is a pause within the downtrend (a bear flag), not a reversal: no structure reclaimed and lower highs intact, with heavy supply at $0.105-0.110 overhead and open sell-side liquidity at the $0.0791 cycle low.

The read is unambiguously bearish, but $0.093 is the worst spot to initiate — price is on support with selling exhausting and a minor 4H divergence; the edge is the rally short or the breakdown short, not the chase.

BTC caveat: ALGO is a high-beta alt that will follow BTC — a BTC bounce could power the relief rally into the $0.097-0.105 short zone, whereas a BTC breakdown sends ALGO straight through $0.0879. OI, Funding and CVD were unavailable in the feed; EMAs were computed directly from daily closes as the study-window readout proved crosshair-sensitive.
bottom_line: Trend-Following (short) — not a reversal or mean-reversion long. The edge is the rally short into $0.097-0.105 or a confirmed breakdown of $0.0879, not chasing price at $0.093.

bullish_upgrade.title: Bullish Invalidation
bullish_upgrade.subtitle: Invalidates Bearish Bias
checks: 4H close back above $0.105-0.108 (range floor + daily 20/50 EMA)
bullish_upgrade.result: Bearish continuation thesis breaks; bias upgrades from Bearish to Neutral.

bull_case: Deeply oversold (-66%) with sell-volume drying into the $0.088 base and a mild 4H higher-low divergence — fuel for a relief bounce to $0.097-0.105.
bear_case: Intact downtrend below every mean with heavy supply overhead — the $0.088-0.097 base is a bear flag resolving toward the $0.0791 cycle low.

verdict.rationale: Conditional short, not a trade to put on now at $0.093 — you're mid-range, sitting on support with selling drying up (the worst spot to enter). It becomes a take on a rally into $0.097-0.105 to short, or a confirmed 4H break below $0.0879. Until one fires: no position.

rows.label: Entry Zone
rows.note: Sell the rally / supply shelf (or break < $0.0879)

failure_scenario: The oversold $0.088 base produces a relief squeeze back into the $0.097-0.105 supply — trapping shorts entered at the lows — before the trend resumes; or, less likely, $0.088/$0.0791 holds as a double-bottom and a genuine reversal begins.
conclusion: Trend-Following (Short) — Bearish Trend Continuation, explicitly not a reversal or mean-reversion long.
